request.recipient: Input Output Global / Intersect administrative treasury governance
request.what: Fund IO: Hydra to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2 through performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and developer experience workstreams.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade Layer 2 on Cardano and a production-ready scaling solution for sub-second finality with L1-grade settlement guarantees.
The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 and says the funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
Hydra is claimed to provide sub-second finality, near-zero or zero fees inside a head, high throughput, and L1-anchored settlement.
The proposal says Hydra has powered or is used by Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal claims performance work will deliver 2x to 10x improvements in snapshot signing and memory profile and reduce L1 fees through on-chain contract optimization.
The proposal claims Cardano L1 has over two hours of finality, about $0.17 per transaction, and roughly 7 to 10 TPS, while competing platforms offer faster finality, lower fees, and higher TPS.

The proposal claims Hydra applications can increase Cardano ecosystem activity, TVL, L1 settlement usage, and protocol or treasury revenue through head lifecycle transactions and optionally routed internal fees.

The proposal says Hydra aligns with treasury KPIs for TVL, monthly active users, monthly transactions, throughput capacity, reliability and uptime, and annual protocol revenue, and with Pillars 1, 2, 4, and 5.
The proposal claims many current Hydra use cases rely on the requested improvements and may migrate to competing chains if the work slips.
The proposal identifies provisional users under evaluation including Bodega Market, Atlas Defi, Wingriders, Houselink, European Public Network, and others.

summary: The anchor presents a large treasury request for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, with many high-impact technical and adoption claims but limited budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, or community-impact detail in the supplied text.
